title: RAG Ingestion Output
description: Labels for pre-cut chunks, emitted by the rag_ingestion prompt (2.0.0). Chunk text is never part of the output. Authored strict-clean: every object sets additionalProperties:false and lists every property in required, so it can be sent under OpenAI strict structured-output mode without a 400.

title_guess.description: Best guess at the document title, or null when the source gives none.

content_type.description: Document kind, e.g. youtube_video, government_document, testimony.

language.description: BCP-47-ish language tag of the source text, e.g. 'en'.

provenance.description: Where this document came from — URL or file path.

integrity_flags.description: Source-quality warnings, e.g. ocr_noise, heavy_redaction, missing_pages, secondary_repost.

chunks.description: One label entry per chunk_id given in the input. Chunk text is cut by code and is not returned.

chunk_id.description: One of the chunk_ids given in the input, e.g. 'c01'.

heading_path.description: Section path this chunk sits under, or null.

claims_hint.description: Claims made in this chunk only, stated short.

do_not_embed_reasons.description: Non-empty means the pipeline drops this chunk before embedding.
